user.title: Hybrid Climate Setup
user.description:
Set up your whole-home HVAC orchestration system.

**Configuration found:** {zone_count} zones, {device_count} devices

data_description.master_name: Display name for the master climate entity

error.no_yaml_config: No YAML configuration found. You can configure zones and devices via the options menu after setup.

global_settings.title: Global Settings
global_settings.description: Configure the master entity, sensors, and outdoor temperature limits.

data_description.outdoor_sensor: sensor.* or weather.* entity for outdoor readings
data_description.occupancy_entity: binary_sensor.* or input_boolean.* tracking home occupancy
data_description.tou_rate_sensor: sensor.* entity whose state indicates the current rate period (e.g., 'peak', 'off_peak')
data_description.never_heat_above: Disable heating when outdoor temperature exceeds this value
data_description.never_cool_below: Disable cooling when outdoor temperature is below this value

zones.title: Zones ({zone_count})
zones.description: Select a zone to edit, or add a new zone.

zone_basics.title: Zone: Basic Settings
zone_basics.description: Configure zone identity and temperature sensors.

data_description.sensors: Leave empty to use device's built-in sensor
data_description.aggregation: How to combine multiple sensor readings
data_description.smoothing_samples: Number of samples to average (1 = no smoothing)

zone_heat_stages.title: Zone: {zone_name} - Heat Stages
zone_heat_stages.description: Configure heating stages. Stage 1 activates first; Stage 2 adds devices when Stage 1 can't keep up.

data_description.stage1_threshold: Activate when this far below target
data_description.stage2_threshold: Activate Stage 2 when this far below target
data_description.stage2_time_escalation: Or activate after Stage 1 runs this long without satisfaction
data_description.stage2_outdoor_min: Only use Stage 2 when outdoor temp is above this (for heat pump efficiency)

data_description.stage1_threshold: Activate when this far above target
data_description.stage2_threshold: Activate Stage 2 when this far above target
data_description.stage2_time_escalation: Or activate after Stage 1 runs this long without satisfaction

zone_settings.title: Zone: {zone_name} - Settings
zone_settings.description: Configure zone control behavior, opportunistic heating, and outdoor reset overrides.

data_description.min_runtime: Minimum time devices must run before turning off
data_description.opportunistic_enabled: Allow this zone to piggyback on boiler cycles from other zones
data_description.opportunistic_threshold: Activate opportunistic heating when this far below setpoint
data_description.override_outdoor_reset: Use zone-specific outdoor reset limits instead of global
data_description.disable_cool_limit: Allow cooling regardless of outdoor temperature (e.g., for basements)
data_description.zone_never_cool_below: Only cool when outdoor temp is above this (leave empty to use global)
data_description.disable_heat_limit: Allow heating regardless of outdoor temperature
data_description.zone_never_heat_above: Only heat when outdoor temp is below this (leave empty to use global)
data_description.allow_command_devices: Select devices whose manual thermostat changes should sync back to the zone setpoint. One toggle per device applies across all stages.

zone_pi_settings.title: Zone: {zone_name} - PI Control
zone_pi_settings.description: Configure PI controller for regulated devices. The controller adjusts device setpoints based on error to improve comfort.

data_description.pi_devices: Which devices should receive adjusted setpoints
data_description.kp: How aggressively to respond to current error
data_description.ki: How aggressively to respond to accumulated error
data_description.k_ext: Factor to adjust based on outdoor temperature (0 = disabled)
data_description.offset_max: Maximum setpoint adjustment in either direction
data_description.balance_point: Outdoor temperature where no adjustment is needed

zone_tou.title: Zone: {zone_name} - TOU Optimization
zone_tou.description: Configure Time-of-Use rate optimization. When a peak rate period is detected, the system pre-conditions before the peak and relaxes setpoints during the peak to reduce electric device runtime.

data_description.tou_heat_pre_condition_minutes: Minutes before peak to pre-heat (raise heat setpoint to warm up early)
data_description.tou_heat_relaxation_amount: Degrees to lower the heat setpoint during peak (reduce heating demand)
data_description.tou_cool_pre_condition_minutes: Minutes before peak to pre-cool (lower cool setpoint to cool down early)
data_description.tou_cool_relaxation_amount: Degrees to raise the cool setpoint during peak (reduce cooling demand)

devices.title: Device Behaviors
devices.description: Select a device to configure its idle behavior.

device_idle.title: Device: {device_id}
device_idle.description: Configure what this device does when its zone is satisfied.

data_description.action: Turn off or maintain a setback temperature
data_description.setback: Degrees below (heat) or above (cool) target when idle

device_edit.title: Device: {device_id}
device_edit.description: Configure this device's capabilities and idle behavior.

data_description.can_heat: Device can be used for heating
data_description.can_cool: Device can be used for cooling
data_description.action: Turn off or maintain a setback temperature
data_description.setback: Degrees below (heat) or above (cool) target when idle

heat_sources.title: Heat Source Groups ({source_count})
heat_sources.description: Group devices that share a heat source (e.g., boiler) for opportunistic heating.

heat_source_edit.title: Heat Source Group
heat_source_edit.description: Configure devices that share this heat source. When one zone heats, others can piggyback.

data_description.devices: Climate devices that share this heat source

presets.title: Preset Modes
presets.description: Configure behavior for each master mode.

preset_edit.title: Preset: {mode_name}
preset_edit.description: Configure how zones behave in this mode.

data_description.use_zone_setpoint: Which zone setpoint to use in this mode
data_description.setpoint_offset: Additional offset to apply to zone setpoints
data_description.disable_all: Turn off all zones in this mode

conflicts.title: Device Conflicts ({rule_count})
conflicts.description: Configure device mutex rules. When a device is heating/cooling one zone, it can block other zones.

conflict_edit.title: {edit_mode} Mutex Rule
conflict_edit.description: When a device is active in a zone, it can prevent other zones from heating or cooling.

data_description.device: The climate device this rule applies to
data_description.mode: Heating or cooling mode that triggers the block
data_description.for_zone: The zone that triggers the block when this device is active
data_description.block_heat: Zones that cannot heat while this rule is active
data_description.block_cool: Zones that cannot cool while this rule is active

error.invalid_temp_range: Never heat above must be less than never cool below (e.g., heat limit 55°F < cool limit 63°F).
error.master_name_required: Please enter a name for the master entity.
error.zone_name_required: Please enter a display name for the zone.
error.zone_id_exists: A zone with this ID already exists.
error.source_devices_required: Please select at least one device.
error.source_id_exists: A group with this ID already exists.
error.no_blocks_specified: Please specify at least one zone to block.

abort.cannot_delete_yaml_zone: Cannot delete zones defined in YAML. Remove from configuration.yaml instead.
abort.cannot_delete_yaml_source: Cannot delete heat sources defined in YAML. Remove from configuration.yaml instead.
abort.cannot_delete_yaml_rule: Cannot delete mutex rules defined in YAML. Remove from configuration.yaml instead.
